notes.subject: עמדות
notes.rationale: ʿomdot ke popego e thehilweng ya 'ho ema' e emisitswe hore e hlalose maoto, e seng sebapadi se itseng.

notes.subject: היו
notes.rationale: hebrew haya e nyametse ka ho se felletseng mme e hatelletsoe ho feta kopu e bonolo.

notes.subject: עמדות היו
notes.rationale: lianane tse ngata li bala 'a ntse a eme'; ylt e bala 'a ile a ba a eme' — pilel e sa feleng kgahlano le e phethahetseng.

notes.subject: ירושלים
notes.rationale: lebitso la toropo le bitsoa ka boeona e le bitso, e tsejwa ka Sesotho e le Yerushalayime, e seng Jerusalema.

translation: Maoto a rona a eme ⟨a rona⟩ ka lehlakoreng, a khona ho ema kapa ho tsamaya, ka ⟨את⟩ mendueng ya hao, Yerushalayime.
